lean#12976
Hey, this is my first attempt at contributing to core, do I need to do something here?
IIUC this is waiting for the maintainers to add a changelog-* label
The core team is a bit behind on triaging RFCs and PRs at the moment. It's not unusual for it to take a month or so until a core PR receives feedback.
So it's okay that CI is failing, it doesn't take me off some queue?
No, we don't filter PRs by CI status. If you like you can comment changelog-library on the PR, that should make a bot add the label.
